meta_label_list: 64 pointers indexed by label id ($00-$3F) to the meta_label_NN positions inside the records; $0000 for the 8 unused ids. Generated by the extraction (Label(label,meta_label)); SkipScriptCommands reads it for every jump and every set branch (SceneMetaLoad patch).
scene_meta_0000: Scene $00, the smallest record: display preset 0, the font art (bitmap mode 2 = VRAM word base $6000, where the dialog font lives) and the sprite palette of South Cape at colour $80. No music, no maps.
scene_meta_0001: Scene $01 (South Cape): display preset 3, music $1C, the town tiles and effect tiles, the palette, both metatile sets and both maps. The label meta_label_3E in front of the sprite part (bitmap mode 1, sprite palette at colour $A0, spritemap) is the shared South Cape sprite set: other scenes reach it through jump < #3E > (scene $03, for example).
scene_meta_0003: Scene $03 (a South Cape interior): defines meta_label_01, the shared interior bitmaps and metatile sets, in the middle of its own record, then jumps to meta_label_3E for the sprites. Scenes $04, $05 and $07 load their own palette and maps and jump to meta_label_01.
scene_meta_0006: Scene $06 (Will's house): two music commands (group 0 and group 1), then a branch pair that picks the sprite set from story flags: flag $4C set = meta_label_01 (the shared interior art of scene $03, which then jumps to the South Cape sprites); flag $21 set = meta_label_23 (the main characters, scene $02 art); otherwise it falls through to meta_label_07 (the castle actors) and jumps to meta_label_24 for the interior art.
scene_meta_00AC: Scene $AC (gfx_village): the branch on flag $B3 chooses the music. Flag set = meta_label_32 (bgm_blessing_of_nature); clear = bgm_ominous_whispers, then jump to meta_label_33 over the other track. The shared village art and sprite part follow.
scene_meta_00FF: Scene $FF (inventory), loaded with SceneScriptNoMusic: display preset 0, sprite art and palette, then meta_label_11 in front of the background palette, BG bitmap and the only char-tiles command of the file (flags $80 = VRAM $0000).
scene_meta_list: 256 pointers indexed by scene id ($00-$FF) to the scene_meta_XXXX records; $0000 marks the 25 ids without a record. Generated by the extraction (Lookup(0,1)); FindCurrentScene reads it as [$3A] + scene id x 2 (SceneMetaLoad patch).
